name: ralph
description: Ralph autonomous agent loop for ZCode: generate a PRD, convert it to prd.json user stories, then let each fresh-context iteration implement exactly one story, run the project's checks, commit, and append learnings to progress.txt — with a read-only local dashboard for story status and live loop progress

description_i18n.en: Ralph autonomous agent loop for ZCode: generate a PRD, convert it to prd.json user stories, then let each fresh-context iteration implement exactly one story, run the project's checks, commit, and append learnings to progress.txt — with a read-only local dashboard for story status and live loop progress
description_i18n.zh-CN: Ralph 自主开发循环：生成 PRD → 转成 prd.json 用户故事 → 每轮一个新上下文迭代实现一个故事并跑检查、提交、记录经验，直到全部 passes: true；附只读看板，可看故事状态与循环实时进度
